summary: Classify provider diagnostics without resource name false positives

delivery.outcome: Prevent incidental resource names from creating a provider cooldown; preserve real throttling and publish the focused fix.
nonGoals: No review/check bypass, credential changes or manual cooldown deletion.
No broad cache identity or provider policy change.

architecture.decision: Recognize structured throttling or explicit diagnostic phrases, rather than arbitrary resource-name substrings; retain real429 and403 response-header evidence.
architecture.rollback: Restore prior immutable package artifact and retain shared cache state and publication evidence.

validation.evidence: Regression for the exact gh stderr plus genuine provider limit cases and shared-command cache behavior.
Trusted App approval and merge readback, followed by separately verified consumer adoption.
